items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: So I was called in by Sonny Werblin who was in the band department at that time... I think what they wanted to do was put together a Maxine Sullivan and John Kirby package so that we could make appearances together.

ctx.x: Right. And because of monopolistic tendencies. When I was with Columbia, I had access to radio, recordings, and personal appearances -- that is, vaudeville. And this was just too much power for one company to have. So, Columbia had to give up their artist bureau. And most of the artists that were with Columbia were assigned to MCA. Well, at that time, Kirby was just beginning to work under the aegis of MCA. So I was called in by Sonny Werblin who was in the band department at that time -- See, MCA was noted for…
Sonny Werblin, just as a footnote, is known today as a sports impresario.
